{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(targets)
library(mclust)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

config     <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path("metadata/project_config.yaml"))
annotation <- config$annotation$cell_types

SUBSETS     <- c("hsc", "mnc", "stroma")
RESOLUTIONS <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9)

# Flat named list: cell_type → character vector of markers
marker_list <- list()
for (ct in names(annotation)) {
  m <- annotation[[ct]]$markers
  marker_list[[ct]] <- if (is.list(m)) unlist(m) else as.character(m)
}

all_markers  <- unique(unlist(marker_list))
stroma_types <- c("MSC", "Fibroblast", "Osteolineage", "Chondrocyte",
                  "Pericyte", "Neuronal", "Endothelial_arteriolar",
                  "Endothelial_sinusoidal")
stroma_markers <- unique(unlist(marker_list[stroma_types]))

# Reference IDs and display names.
# Target name pattern: proj_<ref_id>_<subset>  (data.frame in targets cache)
REFERENCES <- list(
  tms_bm   = "TMS Marrow",
  tms_sp   = "TMS Spleen (ctrl)",
  tms_lu   = "TMS Lung (ctrl)",
  tms_ki   = "TMS Kidney (ctrl)",
  bm_atlas = "Marrow Atlas",
  mca_pb   = "MCA Peripheral Blood",
  mca_bm   = "MCA Bone Marrow",
  mca_ckit = "MCA BM c-Kit",
  mca_mes  = "MCA BM Mesenchyme"
)
REF_IDS     <- names(REFERENCES)
COMPARTMENT <- c(hsc = "HSC", mnc = "MNC", stroma = "Stroma")
```

# Guide

## Canonical markers

```{r marker-table, echo=FALSE}
ct_names    <- names(marker_list)
marker_strs <- sapply(marker_list, paste, collapse = ", ")
marker_df   <- data.frame(`Cell type` = ct_names,
                           Markers     = marker_strs,
                           check.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(marker_df, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Reference datasets

```{r ref-table, echo=FALSE}
ref_df_tbl <- data.frame(
  Target         = paste0("proj_", REF_IDS, "_<compartment>"),
  `Display name` = unlist(unname(REFERENCES)),
  Method         = "RunAzimuth",
  check.names    = FALSE)
knitr::kable(ref_df_tbl, row.names = FALSE)
```

TMS Lung and Kidney references serve as negative controls: consistent labelling by lung or kidney cell types signals weak transfer rather than a true bone marrow identity.

# Cross-compartment marker UMAPs

Gene expression UMAPs for each cell-type marker group across all three compartments. Within each tab: rows = genes, columns = HSC \| MNC \| Stroma.

```{r cross-load}
tar_load(anno_meta_hsc)
tar_load(anno_meta_mnc)
tar_load(anno_meta_stroma)
tar_load(anno_expr_hsc)
tar_load(anno_expr_mnc)
tar_load(anno_expr_stroma)
```

::: panel-tabset
```{r cross-umap-plots, results='asis'}
meta_list <- list(HSC = anno_meta_hsc, MNC = anno_meta_mnc, Stroma = anno_meta_stroma)
expr_list <- list(HSC = anno_expr_hsc, MNC = anno_expr_mnc, Stroma = anno_expr_stroma)

for (ct in names(marker_list)) {
  genes   <- marker_list[[ct]]
  n_genes <- length(genes)
  cat("##", ct, "\n\n")

  all_panels <- list()
  for (gene in genes) {
    for (comp in c("HSC", "MNC", "Stroma")) {
      meta <- meta_list[[comp]]
      expr <- expr_list[[comp]]
      if (!gene %in% colnames(expr)) {
        p <- ggplot() +
          annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste0(gene, "\n(absent)"), size = 3) +
          theme_void() + labs(title = paste(comp, "—", gene))
      } else {
        coords <- merge(meta[, c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2")],
                        expr[, c("cell_id", gene)], by = "cell_id")
        coords <- coords[order(coords[[gene]]), ]
        p <- ggplot(coords, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[gene]])) +
          geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
          scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = gene) +
          labs(title = paste0(comp, " — ", gene)) +
          theme_void(base_size = 9) +
          theme(plot.title     = element_text(size = 9),
                legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
                legend.text    = element_text(size = 7))
      }
      all_panels <- c(all_panels, list(p))
    }
  }

  fig_h <- max(2.5, n_genes * 2.8)
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.height = fig_h, fig.width = 11)
  print(wrap_plots(all_panels, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0(ct, " markers"),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
:::

```{r cross-cleanup}
rm(meta_list, expr_list,
   anno_meta_hsc, anno_meta_mnc, anno_meta_stroma,
   anno_expr_hsc, anno_expr_mnc, anno_expr_stroma)
gc()
```

# Clustering resolutions

UMAP coloured by cluster identity at each resolution. Use these panels alongside the ARI and heatmap summaries (in the Reference sections below) to select a final resolution per compartment.

::: panel-tabset
```{r recluster-load}
tar_load(anno_meta_hsc);             tar_load(annotation_recluster_hsc)
tar_load(anno_meta_mnc);             tar_load(annotation_recluster_mnc)
tar_load(anno_meta_stroma);          tar_load(annotation_recluster_stroma)

hsc_df    <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_hsc,    annotation_recluster_hsc)
mnc_df    <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_mnc,    annotation_recluster_mnc)
stroma_df <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_stroma, annotation_recluster_stroma)
rm(anno_meta_hsc, annotation_recluster_hsc,
   anno_meta_mnc, annotation_recluster_mnc,
   anno_meta_stroma, annotation_recluster_stroma)
gc()
```

## HSC

```{r recluster-hsc, fig.height=7, fig.width=13}
plot_resolution_umap_grid(hsc_df, RESOLUTIONS, "HSC")
```

## MNC

```{r recluster-mnc, fig.height=7, fig.width=13}
plot_resolution_umap_grid(mnc_df, RESOLUTIONS, "MNC")
```

## Stroma

```{r recluster-stroma, fig.height=7, fig.width=13}
plot_resolution_umap_grid(stroma_df, RESOLUTIONS, "Stroma")
```
:::

```{r hsc-expr-load}
tar_load(anno_expr_hsc)
```

::: panel-tabset
### Dot plot

```{r hsc-dot, results='asis', fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
for (r in RESOLUTIONS) {
  cat("####", paste("res", r), "\n\n")
  p <- plot_dot_df(anno_expr_hsc, hsc_df, all_markers, r,
                   title = paste0("HSC — res ", r))
  if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Mixing metric & group-correlated genes {#sec-mixing}

`Seurat::MixingMetric()` scores each cell by how much its nearest neighbours come from a different condition (WT vs Het). Low values = well-mixed; high values = segregated.

`Seurat::GroupCorrelation()` then correlates every gene's expression with that per-cell mixing score, surfacing genes whose expression tracks condition segregation in UMAP space.

::: panel-tabset
## HSC

```{r hsc-mix-load}
#| eval: false
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_data_hsc)
```

```{r hsc-mix-umap, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
#| eval: false
mpn_processed_data_hsc$gps <- ifelse(
  stringr::str_detect(mpn_processed_data_hsc$sample.name, "WT"), "WT", "Het")
mpn_processed_data_hsc$mix <- Seurat::MixingMetric(
  object       = mpn_processed_data_hsc,
  grouping.var = "gps",
  reduction    = "umap.nn")
Seurat::FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_data_hsc, "mix", reduction = "umap.nn") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", name = "Mixing\nmetric") &
  labs(title = "HSC — mixing metric (WT vs Het)")
```

```{r hsc-group-corr}
#| eval: false
mpn_processed_data_hsc <- Seurat::GroupCorrelation(
  mpn_processed_data_hsc, var = "mix", assay = "SCT")
hsc_corr <- mpn_processed_data_hsc[["SCT"]]@meta.features %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(mix_r))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))
DT::datatable(hsc_corr,
              caption  = "HSC: genes correlated with mixing metric (|r| descending)",
              rownames = FALSE,
              options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r hsc-mix-cleanup}
#| eval: false
rm(mpn_processed_data_hsc, hsc_corr); gc()
```
